description_en: Retrieves the list of modules supported for authorization
description_zh: 获取授权支持的模块列表
name: GetSupportedModules

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SupportedModuleResponse.description_en: The module information supported by the current vendors, categorized by vendor
SupportedModuleResponse.description_zh: 当前厂商支持的模块信息按照厂商分类返回

SupportedModules.description_en: The list of modules supported by the current vendor
SupportedModules.description_zh: 当前厂商支持的模块列表

Module.description_en:
The module code. Valid values:
HOST: Host
CSPM: Cloud product configuration check
SIEM: CloudSiem
TRIAL: Log audit
Module.description_zh:
模块Code。取值：
HOST：主机
CSPM：云产品配置检查
SIEM：CloudSiem
TRIAL：日志审计

ModuleAuth.description_en:
The module authorization status. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
ModuleAuth.description_zh:
模块授权开关标识。取值：
true：开通
false：未开通

ModuleDisp.description_en: The display name of the module

Vendor.description_en:
The cloud asset vendor. Valid values:

Tencent: Tencent Cloud
HUAWEICLOUD: Huawei Cloud
Azure: Azure
AWS: AWS
Vendor.description_zh:
云资产厂商。取值：

Tencent：腾讯云
HUAWEICLOUD：华为云
Azure：Azure
AWS：AWS
